purpose: Canonical integrity contract for the belief layer. A visible label is not considered populated unless it resolves to substantive descriptive data.
rules: Every tree belief node must resolve to a canonical belief record or an explicitly declared category node.
A populated record requires a non-empty definition; classifications and coordinates are optional unless the record type requires them.
Denominations and movements should remain distinct from parent traditions where the distinction is meaningful.
Project-defined Potatoism material must be marked as project-canon rather than presented as external historical fact.
Missing evidence is recorded as missing rather than replaced with invented detail.
note: This file governs completeness checks; it is not a second belief encyclopedia. Descriptive content remains owned by the canonical religious lexicon, political lexicon and Potatoism datasets.
